boundary_basis: The routine begins after the preceding player animation service returns at 0x001AE618.
Both conditional paths terminate at their own RTS, with the second path ending at 0x001AE64B immediately before ActorType43_PlayerCollisionHandler at 0x001AE64C.
The complete 50-byte body is an isolated motion initializer and does not absorb the neighboring collision-handler range.
evidence: PLAYER_FACING_X_FLIP branch controls only the horizontal launch sign
Both paths write the same upward PLAYER_VY
PLAYER_TERRAIN_BOUNCE_ANIMATION_STATE is the shared terrain-response state consumed by the existing landing/bounce services
conclusion: The former 0x001AE61A-0x001AE64B UNKNOWN range is a complete player-facing launch-motion initializer. Its exact velocity writes and terrain-response-state reset are now represented as a canonical function and RAM symbol.
limitations: No direct ROM call/reference to the entry was identified in the current whole-ROM reference database; the promotion is based on the complete isolated body and its shared player terrain-state side effects.
